Context & provenance

About this edition.

A fascicle of the narrations of Yazid b. Abi Habib (d. 129 AH) as transmitted by al-Layth b. Sa'd, edited by Hamza Ahmad al-Zayn within the collection Ahadith al-Shuyukh al-Kibar (Dar al-Hadith, Cairo). Narrations keep the edition’s printed numbers; a narration that runs onto a second printed page appears again under the same number.

How the text is presented

Catalog header

The first page record repeats the Shamela catalog header (title, author, editor, publisher). It is not reproduced as an entry.

Arabic text

The Arabic is shown exactly as supplied. Where an entry opens with its printed number, the number appears in the label instead of the text. Square brackets and page markers are carried over from the source.

Isnad and matn

Where the Arabic gives a chain before the words, the chain and the words are shown apart and the English is divided at the same point. Entries with no chain say so. The division follows a fixed rule and does not alter the text.

Dating

Century is based on the compiler/associated authority's death year, not a verified date of composition. The date shown is the death year of Yazid b. Abi Habib, 129 AH.

Structure

A fascicle (juz') of numbered narrations, each with its own chain through al-Layth b. Sa'd. A narration that runs onto a second printed page is shown as one narration with its continuation.

Transmitters

The source supplies no separate transmitter data. Where a report states its own chain, the transmission path lists the names exactly as the isnad words them, read from the text between its transmission terms; English names are shown only where they line up one for one with the Arabic. No transmitter is identified beyond the wording of the source.
